notes: Live reading sets only. progressId values are the localStorage and GitHub progress keys; do not change them. Image folders match the set id (images/reading-02 even when the script is reading-02-v3.js). Sets 01–03 keep the historical filename in illustration[0]. From set 04 on, the page loads images/<setId>/<storyId>.jpg and illustration is only the Chinese caption. Obsolete files reading-02.js, reading-02-v2.js, and reading-03.js are not illustration sources.
